newsitem.title: USA: Swisher says buys Carolina Pest for $1.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Swisher says buys Carolina Pest for $1.2 mln.

text.p: Swisher International Inc said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to buy the privately-held Carolina Pest Control Co for $1.2 million.
The company said Carolina Pest Control will serve as a model for its expansion into the pest control industry.
The company said it plans to begin franchising the pest control concept in the near future.
Swisher also said it has sold a Surface Doctor master license to Fix-All Franchising Ltd in Brazil for $150,000.
A company spokeswoman said Surface Doctor is a subsidiary of Swisher. Fix-All has purchased the right to franchise the company in Brazil.
